```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(terra)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(dbscan)
```

```{r}

paolo <- st_read(here("output_data/offshore_wind/Wind_point_locations.shp"))
gwpt <- st_read(here("output_data/offshore_wind/GWPT_offshore_wind_point_locations_all.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., crs = "ESRI:54017")

```
```{r}
coords <- st_coordinates(paolo)
db <- dbscan(coords, eps = 50000, minPts = 5) # cluster within ~2 km
paolo$cluster <- db$cluster

farms <- paolo %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
```

```{r}
matches <- st_join(farms, gwpt, join = st_nearest_feature)
```
